coverage_status: 298 named entries with mechanical summaries: all296 pinned stable records plus2 wiki-confirmed beta additions. Known beta changes are separately labelled; this is not an exhaustive current-beta rules diff.
limits: Requested wiki direct retrieval failed; stable community-extracted game data fills definitions. Two beta additions supplement the stable list. Per-item facts are paraphrases, not copied flavor text; current/latest installed build equivalence is not claimed.

definition_policy: Mechanical fact summaries paraphrased by two researchers, with no flavor text or art. Basic names, source rarity, character ownership, numeric values and triggers retained; related card/enchantment mechanics are referenced rather than fully reproduced.
